codeReview.summary: The shared withIsolatedDataDir() test helper is properly implemented in tests/helpers.ts. It creates a temp directory, sets FT_DATA_DIR, runs the callback, and restores/cleans up in a finally block. The helper has 8 thorough unit tests in helpers.test.ts covering creation, env var setting, restoration, cleanup (including on error), nested async operations, undefined env var, and file I/O. At least 2 existing test files (bookmarks-db.test.ts and bookmarks-service.test.ts) were refactored to use the shared helper. Both validation assertions pass.

issues.description: The helper uses a synchronous mkdtempSync but an async cleanup with rm(). For consistency and to avoid blocking the event loop during test setup, consider using mkdtemp (async) instead of mkdtempSync.
issues.suggestedFix: Change `fs.mkdtempSync(...)` to `await fs.promises.mkdtemp(...)` for consistency with the async cleanup pattern.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The withIsolatedDataDir() helper creates temp directories with prefix 'ft-isolated-' in os.tmpdir(). Tests using this helper are safe to run in parallel since each gets its own temp dir and FT_DATA_DIR value. The helper properly handles both async and sync callbacks.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: tests/helpers.ts creates unique temp dirs via mkdtempSync and restores env vars in finally block. 3 test files now use it.
